info.cls_ename: Department of Mechanical and Computer-Aided Engineering

description.describe_ch: 使用電腦輔助製造工程軟體與技術、其中包含電腦輔助製造工程、電腦數值控制之應用及快速原型製作(3D列印)，進而瞭解與應用現代新製造相關技術。學習電腦輔助製造及3-D列印之軟體應用、方法與技術。
description.describe_eh: Use computer-aided manufacturing engineering software and technology, including computer-aided manufacturing engineering, computer numerical control applications, and rapid prototyping (3D printing) to understand and apply modern new manufacturing related technologies. Learn computer-aided manufacturing and 3-D printing software applications, methods and technologies.

targets.describe_ch: 瞭解何謂現代產業，可說明產品設計與製造程序的關係。
targets.describe_en: Understand what modern industrial is and be able to explain the relationship between of product design and manufacturing process.

targets.describe_ch: 知道於何處可找到相關資訊，並可評估所獲資訊的適用性。
targets.describe_en: Know where to locate and access related information and be able to evaluate the appropriateness of the obtained information.

targets.describe_ch: 能使用電腦輔助技巧在產品設計與製造上。
targets.describe_en: Be able to use computer aid techniques for product design and manufacturing.

targets.describe_ch: 能運用新製造技術，在開發一產品或系統時，提出可行製造的方法。
targets.describe_en: Use new manufacturing technique to propose a manufacturing method for validation when a product or system was developed.

targets.describe_ch: 能以書面或口頭方式將所獲結果與同儕及教師溝通。
targets.describe_en: Communicate results in written or oral form to classmates and the instructor.
